blocks.text: Statistics mathematics ki woh branch (hissa) hai jo data ko samajhne aur analyze karne (jaanchne) mein madad deti hai. Statistics se hum bohat sari information ki saada summary (khulasa) bana sakte hain, jis se nateeja nikalna aasan ho jata hai. Kuch basic (bunyadi) statistical concepts yeh hain: descriptive statistics, measures of central tendency (data ka beech wala ya aam number batane wale tareeqe), measures of dispersion (data kitna phaila hai, yeh batane wale tareeqe) aur probability (kisi cheez ke hone ka chance).

blocks.prompt: Is hisse ke chaar basic statistical concepts bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Descriptive statistics, measures of central tendency, measures of dispersion aur probability.

items: Statistics data ki summary banati hai: descriptive statistics, central tendency, dispersion, probability.
